scope: Cumulative settled partial refunds, exact recovery, protected holds, net benefits, statistics and periodic confirmation compatibility

isolation.mysql: dedicated MySQL 8 container with network none, no published ports; app shares only this isolated network namespace

migrations.backfill: New recovered/refunded columns equal original amount only for previously cancelled holds, reversed confirmations, or released funding allocations; all existing fields/rows retained.

broad_sqlite_before_final_release_lock_f.skip_reason: SQLite lacks select_for_update; all four original cases passed in final real MySQL run.

checks: Partial paid order stays in completed/paid counts and net paid turnover.
Non-divisible team turnover totals exactly 7001 after refund from 8001; actual provider net income is 2100 and 3501 from original credits minus real reversals.
Provider/inviter using one wallet does not add inviter commission to the provider earnings ranking.
Original PAID snapshots, transfer attribution, date/permission/menu behavior and secondary wallet/deposit statistics remain compatible.
Partial service turnover, recent selections, achievements and home rankings read net paid amounts.
Periodic confirmation scanner includes partially refunded completed orders and confirms only the remaining net consumption.

financial_invariants: Cumulative refunds never exceed actual original payment. Each credit uses deterministic monotone cumulative integer apportionment; each operation recovers only the new delta and the final refund exactly clears every original credit.
Seventeen one-unit refunds, multiple providers and inviter credits reconcile exactly without negative recovery deltas.
Each refund has an order-scoped idempotency key and intent fingerprint; successful replay does not alter money or emit new invalidations; conflicting intent returns 409.
Preview binds requested amount, previous refunds, original credits and reversals, wallet/profile/hold facts; stale or amount-substituted plans roll back.
Only the same order remaining income hold can fund recovery. Pending withdrawal freezes, unrelated order holds, protected deposits and platform deposit pools remain intact.
Partially recovered holds retain their original amount and maturity; release transfers only amount minus recovered_amount; a fully recovered hold is cancelled once.
Original ledger, report approvals, completion and settlement timestamps remain; a completed order count decreases only on final full refund.

Consumption confirmations and point funding allocations retain originals plus cumulative refunded amounts; points and unused VIP/gift rights follow net eligibility. Consumed benefits retain auditable history.
Partial aftersale tickets can reopen in a new request round; full refunds close the order, while partial refunds keep COMPLETED/PARTIALLY_REFUNDED.
Owner summaries expose only the owner net income, recovered amount and remaining order hold; full recovery lines remain restricted to authorized refund staff.
Commit-only wallet/order invalidations do not fire on failed, rolled-back or replayed operations.

real_mysql_bug_found_and_fixed.cause: Release held wallet/hold and waited for order shared FK lock when inserting EARNINGS_RELEASE, while refund held order and waited for wallet.
real_mysql_bug_found_and_fixed.fix: Release locks the source order before wallet and hold, with one transaction per hold and no global financial mutex.
real_mysql_bug_found_and_fixed.retested: Final real MySQL 30/30 PASS, including partial release/refund and existing full-refund release concurrency.

cleanup.guard: Exact name/image mysql:8.0/network none/zero published ports inspected before deletion

limits: Suite executions overlap and must not be summed as unique tests.

Broad SQLite preceded the final release-order-lock fix; the final targeted suites above ran after that fix. The last statistics/selector changes were read-only and did not change the tested money paths.
Dashboard history without an unambiguous original provider credit keeps a net snapshot estimate; official labelled provider credits use exact successful ledger and reversal amounts.
This report is isolated backend evidence. Live three-role UI and final read-only database audit are recorded separately by the coordinating agent.
